description: This file defines application configuration settings for a gym management system, loading environment variables, and providing a Settings class with various configuration options such as app environment, database URLs, security keys, payment settings, and OAuth credentials. It also includes a cached function to retrieve the settings instance.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A Pydantic model that encapsulates application configuration loaded from environment variables, with default values and descriptions.

methods.name: cors_origins
methods.description: Returns a list of allowed CORS origins based on environment variable settings, including defaults and fallback options.
